source: Barbulescu et al., Nat Commun 15:7541 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41467-024-52009-x. Fig. 2g (pie percentages) and Supplementary Fig. 9b (per-mouse tables), transcribed 2026-10-16 and checked against the PDF text layer.
matrix_orientation: rows = From (G, C, A, T), columns = To (G, C, A, T); diagonal is null
note: In Wt #3, Wt #4 and Maea #1-#3 the printed cells do not sum to the printed totals (Wt #3 cells 118 vs 123; Wt #4 row C 31 vs 21; Maea #1 cells 70 vs 58; Maea #2 row A 23 vs 16; Maea #3 row T 16 vs 17). The paper's plotted frequencies (Figure 2h, in source_data) match the printed totals for the four wild-type mice and Maea #3-#4; for Maea #1 they use the cell sum (70) and for Maea #2 its 32 sequences x 577 bp rather than the printed 24,905 nt. Comparisons use the source data where they exist; spectra use the printed cells.
mouse_mapping: wt #k and Maea #k are folders 2.k and 2.(k+4) of the original Benchling project: the read counts match where every page of the folder was seen (2.3 = 23, 2.4 = 21, 2.5 = 58, 2.7 = 50).

source_data.source: The paper's Source Data file (41467_2024_52009_MOESM6_ESM.xlsx, nature.com), sheets 'Figure 2g', 'Figure 2h' and 'Figure 2i', read 2026-10-16. Mice are in the order of the per-mouse tables; the Figure 2g sheet names them by folder (2.1.txt to 2.8.txt), as in mouse_mapping.
source_data.analysis: SHMTool (Methods: 'Analysis of sequencing was analyzed through SHMtool', ref. 48, MacCarthy et al. 2009); the Figure 2g sheet: 'generated through SHMtool'.
source_data.checks: Figure 2i's per-mouse values reproduce the printed Figure 2i P values exactly (two-tailed unpaired t: Ts 0.0028, Tv 0.0285). Figure 2h's printed P (0.0143) is not what a one-tailed t-test gives on its own plotted values (0.0001); it equals 1/70, the smallest one-tailed Mann-Whitney P for 4 against 4 mice.
